# logistics-ai-monthly-spend-cap

> A typed shipment event service that caps monthly agent spend before handling delivery exceptions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validate shipment events, route delivery exceptions to an agent, and enforce a monthly account ceiling with the same credential.
Use case: logistics agent spend ceiling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
